Understanding of forced migration and refugee issues, particularly in the Jordanian context. Experience or demonstrated understanding of advocacy, external engagement and stakeholder relations. Strong networking and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage professionally with NGOs, UN agencies, donors, civil society and other stakeholders.
